options.content: **Traces are wired but empty until the apps emit spans.**  Set on each Coolify service:  `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.200.2.51:4318` , `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=<name>` , `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp` .  Spans flow `app -> Alloy(.51) -> OTel Collector(.52) -> Jaeger`, and RED metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`) are derived automatically.
